name: Olga
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy Second Year
Class: Crusader

A second-year student at Yggdrasil Girls' Magical Academy, who enrolled because she wanted to learn magic skills to complement her sword fighting abilities as a crusader. 

While she appears to be a graceful and dignified lady at first sight, she takes an overtly odd interest in the [url=/c64356]protagonist's[/url] frequent dirty jokes.  

Her extremely competitive nature often causes her to bring misfortune upon herself.  Her sword fighting skills her are not to be underestimated, however.  Beware of her her special double-jump vertical slash attack her with her her Sword of Patriot Lightning!
